I think / am afraid that using Anthropic thinking mode is fundamentally incompatible with using an OpenAI compatible API. The `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` client just ignores the "reasoning" parts of `"assistant"` messages when making a request:

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/dfa8a1c9c8b16499f5d1992a675a1f7037ee9300/packages/openai-compatible/src/chat/openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts#L214

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/dfa8a1c9c8b16499f5d1992a675a1f7037ee9300/packages/openai-compatible/src/chat/openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts#L313

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/dfa8a1c9c8b16499f5d1992a675a1f7037ee9300/packages/openai-compatible/src/chat/openai-compatible-chat-language-model.ts#L201

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/e31be1cb65a9ab4e4938d61a56b17736df9dd335/packages/openai-compatible/src/chat/convert-to-openai-compatible-chat-messages.ts#L76-L104

This is makes it incompatible with [Anthropic extended thinking](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/extended-thinking) mode because that requires [perserving the thinking blocks](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/extended-thinking#preserving-thinking-blocks).

I'm unsure if the "OpenAI compatible API" spec would allow for reasoning parts to be sent back (in which case we could add an option to the `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` client to optionally include the reasoning parts, and then hope that the server [LiteLLM] could process that correctly...), or if this is just not permitted.

Sorry to have wasted your time :/

I hope this issue thread is at least helpful to others who are in the same situation as me. (There seem to be at least a couple of LiteLLM users out there.)


UPDATE: The git version is the key, git introduced rev-parse's path-format option in git 2.31.0

@rekram1-node short explanation i used the Singular to differentiate from the vercelAi option that is plural.

but thanks to your asking i think my naming is not correct for the solution. also some time after the issue was opened it seems that the default URL generation by opencode or vercelAi  changed for Azure from using the "completion" set to the "responses".

and now after i reviewed my changes again, this was the actual fix put in here. because the V1 vs Deployment base URL can be fixed by just setting the vercelAi option "useDeploymentBasedUrls" (plural) but now this fixes the first aspect of the URL generation issue (using the Deplyoment url style vs the v1 url style) and my PR now also provides a way to choose between the "completion" endpoint or the "responses" endpoint.

Therefore i think the option name i suggested in the PR for opendcode should be changed, I'll update the PR later.

here is a full example of generated URLs with the different settings:

For easy use i'll name the "useDeploymentBasedUrls" from vercelAi  
and the suggested PR "useDeploymentBasedUrl" to be used in opencode (now named "useCompletionUrls")
both are boolean.

this will represent options read from the opencode.json file => {api-version} => will mean the { "provider": "azure": { "options": { "apiVersion": "2025-01-01-preview" } } } etc.

useDeploymentBasedUrls: **false** 
useCompletionUrls: **false**
> Generates: {baseURL}/v1/responses?api-version={apiVersion}

useDeploymentBasedUrls: **true** 
useCompletionUrls: **false**
> Generates: %baseURL%/deployments/%Model%/responses?api-version=%api-version%

useDeploymentBasedUrls: **false**
useCompletionUrls: **true**
> Generates: %baseURL%/v1/responses?api-version=%api-version%

useDeploymentBasedUrls: **true** 
useCompletionUrls: **true**
> Generates: %baseURL%/deployments/%Model%/chat/completions?api-version=%api-version%


so currently you would need both options to get the deployment part (by vercelAi) and the completion (by opencode option) to get the URL by Azure Foundry Models will need.

I did not found an option in the [VrecelAi Manual](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/main/content/providers/01-ai-sdk-providers/04-azure.mdx?plain=1) that can also set the usage of responses vs completion.


so for my ending words i'd say the suggestion option name by my PR should be changed to "useCompletionUrls" or something to make it easy to understand what this actual changes in behavior and maybe add this options of configuration to the configuration documentation for others to know.
